main.title: Projects
main.subtitle: Selected machine learning, LLM, and software engineering projects.

projects.title: Face Recognition
projects.description: Developed a one-shot face verification model using a Siamese network with an Xception backbone and transfer learning. The model compares image pairs using Euclidean distance and contrastive loss, achieving 97.6% verification accuracy on LFW and 96.25% on ORL. This bachelor project was subsequently published in the Journal of Electrical and Computer Engineering Innovations.

projects.title: Music Genre Classification
projects.description: Built a robust music genre classifier using VGG19, Keras, and signal processing. It extracted audio features, generated spectrograms, and trained a model for precise 10-genre categorization. This classifier facilitated music collection organization, personalized recommendations, and adaptable streaming platforms through audio analysis and deep learning fusion. The model achieved 80% accuracy on training data and 61% accuracy on validation data. I worked on this project to improve my classification and NLP skills.

projects.title: Predict Car Prices With k-Nearest Neighbor
projects.description: k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN) was used to predict car prices based on quality. It worked by comparing a car's attributes and quality to similar cars and estimating its cost. This method helped assess car valuations for buying or selling, providing insights into fair market values based on quality. The model achieved 90% accuracy on validation data. This was a mini project inspired by YouTube.

projects.title: Truecaller-and-RocketReach-scraping
projects.description: Wrote scrapers to parse information from Truecaller and RocketReach using three different approaches in isolated virtual environments.

projects.title: Customer Support Bot
projects.description: Built a customer support bot using Cohere for booking flights, cars, and hotels. Used LangChain and GPT-4 embeddings to create the bot's chains, with SQL Server for data storage and retrieval.

projects.title: Nano-GPT
projects.description: Built a Nano-GPT model using a Kaggle dataset of epic poems, with the goal of creating a poem generator.

projects.title: Micrograd-exercise
projects.description: A tiny scalar-valued autograd engine and a neural network library built on top of it with a PyTorch-like API.
